incident.remarks:
Fracture of the port main-engine sea-water cooling line; Attack Party assessed MAJOR damage after a second leak developed.
SSEP closed up in full; leak plugged and patched, two portable pumps reduced the water to bilge level within 40 minutes.
Lesson: second portable pump to be stowed nearer the engine-room escape trunk.
